# Third-party notices

> Generated by `scripts/windows-third-party-notices.ps1`; do not edit by hand.
> The checked-in machine-readable companion is
> `packaging/windows/third-party-inventory.json`.

Gilbreth is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later. See `LICENSE.md` in the installed program directory.

## Scope and method

This notice covers the exact package-scoped Cargo.lock closure for `gilbreth-app@0.1.2` on
`x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`: 263 external normal packages and
20 build-only packages (283 external non-development packages total), plus
6 Gilbreth workspace packages. Dev dependencies and dependencies for other targets are excluded.
Build-only crates are retained conservatively even though their code is not linked into the installed executable.

For packages offering alternative licenses, upstream license files are retained for review. Gilbreth explicitly
uses the Apache-2.0 option for `self_cell`; its alternative GPL-2.0-only text is intentionally excluded.
Package identities, license expressions, source repositories, exact input hashes, and embedded-asset hashes
are recorded in the companion inventory. Re-running verification fails closed on graph or byte changes.

## Embedded assets and non-Cargo runtime components

The app embeds Inter and IBM Plex Mono. Because `FontDefinitions::default()` remains the glyph fallback,
it also embeds egui/epaint default Hack, Noto Emoji, Ubuntu Light, and emoji-icon-font assets.
The pinned Rust standard library and runtime are statically linked; their complete toolchain copyright
bundle, including Rust in-tree and out-of-tree third-party notices, is retained below.
The generated Setup and installed uninstaller contain Inno Setup and LZMA SDK code; bundled SQLite is
statically compiled into the application. The Microsoft runtime/system-component disposition is included
for completeness. Exact binary/source hashes are in the companion inventory.

| Component | Version | Relationship | License/disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | bundled project assets | embedded application fonts | OFL-1.1 |
| IBM Plex Mono | bundled project asset | embedded application font | OFL-1.1 |
| Rust standard library and runtime | 1.96.0 | statically linked standard library and runtime | Apache-2.0 OR MIT, including bundled third-party notices |
| Inno Setup | 6.7.3 | generated installer and installed uninstaller runtime | Inno Setup License |
| LZMA SDK | Inno Setup 6.7.3 component | installer LZMA2 compression/decompression code | Public Domain |
| SQLite | 3.53.1 | statically linked bundled database engine | Public Domain |
| Microsoft Visual C++ runtime and Windows system components | MSVC 14.44.35207 / Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0 | static runtime portions; non-redistributed operating-system DLLs | Microsoft applicable license and redistribution terms |

## Cargo license and notice texts

Identical upstream texts are deduplicated by the SHA-256 of their LF-normalized UTF-8 content.

### Microsoft Visual C++ runtime and Windows system components

Source input: `packaging/windows/notices/Microsoft-runtime-disposition.txt`

~~~~text
Microsoft runtime and Windows system-component disposition
============================================================

The Windows release is built with the statically linked Microsoft Visual C++
runtime selected by the pinned Visual Studio Build Tools license. Those
redistributable runtime portions are governed by Microsoft's applicable
license and redistribution terms.

Windows system DLLs listed by the PE dependency policy are supplied by the
operating system and are not redistributed in the Gilbreth installer.
~~~~

The exact release source is identified by `source.tag` and `source.commit` in the release
manifest shipped beside the installer, and is available from
<https://github.com/Tyler-Systems/Gilbreth>.
